surfaces.grok_wire: Transport: 4-byte big-endian u32 length header then one JSON value per frame; MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 64MB; EOF => ConnectionClosed. Client→Server envelopes (tag "type", snake_case): {"type":"register","client_type":"<string>","mode":"stdio"|"headless","capabilities":{"yolo_mode":bool,"auto_mode":bool,"default_model":string|null,"client_version":string|null,"code_nav_enabled":bool,"terminal":bool,"fs_read":bool,"fs_write":bool,"status_line":bool}}; {"type":"acp","payload":"<one JSON-RPC 2.0 line>"}; {"type":"control","request_id":"<string>","command":{...}}; {"type":"ping"}; {"type":"disconnect"}. Server→Client: {"type":"registered","client_id":u64,"ready":bool,"leader_protocol_version":1,"leader_binary_version":"...","leader_capabilities":{"control_v1":bool,"runtime_cpu_profile":bool,"profile_formats":["svg"|"folded"],"workspace_exposure":bool,"relaunch_v1":bool}}; if ready=false the client MUST wait for {"type":"leader_ready"} before any ACP traffic; {"type":"acp","payload":"..."} both directions; {"type":"shutting_down","reason":"auto_update"|"manual"|"idle_timeout","delay_ms":0} then {"type":"shutdown"}; {"type":"pong"}; {"type":"error","code":i32,"message":"..."}. Internal agent methods are wire-named with a leading underscore so the decoder routes them to ext_method/ext_notification: "_x.ai/internal/auth_cleared", "_x.ai/internal/evict_sessions", "_x.ai/internal/reload_all_mcp_servers", "_x.ai/internal/reload_models", "_x.ai/internal/reload_models_cache", "_x.ai/internal/reload_project_mcp_servers", "_x.ai/internal/reload_skills", "_x.ai/internal/reload_workflows".

surfaces.grok_wire: On the PARENT session's channel: session/update {"sessionUpdate":"subagent_spawned","subagentId":"<id>","parentSessionId":"<id>","parentPromptId":"<id>"?,"childSessionId":"<id>","subagentType":"general-purpose"|"explore"|"plan"|custom,"description":"<short>","effectiveContextSource":"new"|"resumed"?,"contextNormalized":bool,"capabilityMode":"read-only"?,"persona"?,"role"?,"model"?,"resumedFrom"?,"workflowRunId"?}. Then ~2s cadence: {"sessionUpdate":"subagent_progress","subagentId","parentSessionId","childSessionId","durationMs":u64,"turnCount":u32,"toolCallCount":u32,"tokensUsed":u64,"contextWindowTokens":u64,"contextUsagePct":u8,"toolsUsed":["..."],"errorCount":u32}. Terminal: {"sessionUpdate":"subagent_finished","subagentId","childSessionId","status":"completed"|"failed"|"cancelled","error"?,"toolCalls":u32,"turns":u32,"durationMs":u64}. Child session updates arrive on the parent channel and are routed by child_session_id. Ext request "x.ai/subagent/cancel" params {"sessionId":"<id>","subagentId":"<id>"} → result {"subagentId":"<id>","cancelled":bool,"outcome":{"kind":"cancelled"|"already_finished"|"not_found","status"?}}; also "x.ai/subagent/get" and "x.ai/subagent/list_running" {"sessionId"}.
surfaces.live_expect: Grok-wire: subagent_spawned names a child_session_id and subagent_type; at least one subagent_progress shows tokensUsed/contextWindowTokens; subagent_finished arrives with status completed. Gents-document: a Task document transitions running → completed with tool_call_count matching the finished event.
